children: Finland textile material innovator's H1 revenue rose yr/yr as test runs and partnerships advanced
Operating loss narrowed, mainly due to absence of prior year's impairment charge
Company announced intention to pursue U.S. IPO and Nasdaq dual listing after period end
Spinnova will not give financial guidance for 2026
Company says commercial demand for SPINNOVA fibre exceeds current capacity
Company expects to continue test runs and prepare for broader production ramp-up in autumn
WOODSPIN DEMO PLANT - Co said test runs at Woodspin demonstration plant validated production concepts and improved fibre quality
ECOSYSTEM EXPANSION - Co expanded ecosystem with new partners to support fibre scale-up and commercial adoption
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialty chemicals peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Spinnova Oyj is €0.45, about 4.7% below its August 28 closing price of €0.47
